description: Minimize generic ALU cells while preserving exhaustive RTL and synthesized-netlist correctness.
interface: Eight-bit A/B, three-bit opcode: add, subtract, AND, OR, XOR, NOT A, left shift, right shift. Carry means carry-out for add and no borrow for subtract. Signed arithmetic overflow; zero from result; logical and shift carry/overflow zero.

formal.scope: All defined binary ALU inputs, combinational candidate against the fixed original ALU.
assumptions: Inputs are binary; physical timing, glitches and analog behavior are outside scope.
